meta.title: Improve behavior library performance
meta.body_summary: Optimize behavior library performance by adding HashSet for duplicate checks, clearing set on detach, reusing behavior collection in Interaction event handlers, and preallocating results list.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added HashSet and caching optimizations; author self-closed after ~22h with no human review; bot suggested unit tests but no blocking.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 87 changed lines across 2 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. As a performance micro-optimization PR, it was closed by the author without merge, possibly due to inability to test locally (dotnet not found). The small scale fits typical low-risk perf changes, but lack of testability likely led to closure.

core_change_summary.description: In BehaviorCollection.cs, added _behaviorSet HashSet to check duplicates in O(1) and cleared/removed alongside _oldCollection. In Interaction.cs, cached GetBehaviors(d) in local variable to avoid repeated calls and preallocated results list with actions.Count capacity.
change_trajectory: Single commit by author with message 'Optimize behavior handling'.

review_signals.summary: Copilot bot reviewed the changes, noted the optimizations, and suggested adding unit tests for the new duplicate-detection logic.
Nitpick: suggested extracting repeated pattern of retrieving and invoking methods on behaviors into a helper.
